name: Mediaflow
description: Integrates the Mediaflow DAM so editors browse and import assets into Drupal media.
project_description:
With the Mediaflow and Drupal integration, you can easily access your Mediaflow image library directly from within Drupal, allowing you to insert images without the need to download them first. The integration ensures that all images meet the required quality and format, while also managing licenses and consent.

 Mediaflow automatically tracks when, where, and by whom images are used. The inserted images are transferred to Drupal, ensuring that your website’s performance remains unaffected and independent of Mediaflow for ongoing functionality.

 No need to log in to Mediaflow separately - authentication happens seamlessly through the integration, streamlining your workflow for greater efficiency.

 Mediaflow - Digital assets, video and branding – all in one place 
 

 
 ▶ Watch an introduction to Mediaflow 

 More information can be found at https://www.mediaflow.com/ 

 Installation 
 We recommend using composer to install the Mediaflow module

 composer require drupal/mediaflow 

but you also download the module as a compressed file and unpack the contents to your module directory.

 For installation, please follow the steps described in Mediaflows knowledge base ( version in Swedish ).

 A guide to how you insert images and videos in Drupal is also available in the knowledge base ( version in Swedish ).

 Version 2.0.0 
 Version 2.0.0 is the start of a new era when it comes to Mediaflow and the Drupal module. We are working on getting the module approved to the correct status regarding security is shown, and from now on there will be more activity in the issue queue from our side, and also more frequent updates to the module - from small issues to new functionality.

 Important information regarding version 2.0.0 
 Earlier versions had 2 of our 3 API keys hardcoded, but from version 2.x.x on you need to enter the 3 API keys in a settings form in Drupal.

So if you're upgrading to version 2.0.0 please reach out to support@mediaflow.com to acquire new API keys. In time the old API keys will be rendered useless.
